The charset guard in scripts/create_issue_benchmark.py:127-130 rejects any scenario_id containing a char outside [A-Za-z0-9._-], plus the literals '.' and '..', plus exact-string duplicates via a `seen` set. Falsifying constructions accepted (NOT rejected) by this guard: a trailing-dot id like 'a.'
